component.name: goCrawler
component.summary: Topic-restricted crawler that builds curated text corpora

description.p: goCrawler downloads web pages, filters them by language, length, relevance and uniqueness, and stores curated text, token frequencies and a ranking in a local SQLite database. It is a command-line tool aimed at text-mining and corpus-building workflows.
First packaged release: configurable ranking, robots.txt policy, resumable crawls and local cache.
